checkpointSelection.criterion: Improve full-development harmonic known/unseen macro top-5; no worse rank on any of eight reported train/development-family cases, strictly better Lora/Montserrat ranks. Smallest encoder within one absolute percentage point of best eligible development score.
checkpointSelection.scope: Reported examples are now explicitly development-selection data. No final-family query or third phrase result enters selection. Final catalog reference images supply distractor candidates. Selection does not establish top-one correctness on every reported example.
